answer: Each identity must lock a stake before it ranks, and payouts scale with stake, never headcount. A farm of ten thousand fresh wallets needs ten thousand times the single-account stake left idle, plus an attestation from an established peer. Newcomers face a mechanism challenge seeded like a pigment dye: they must explain one mechanism in original prose, so copied text is filtered out. A new jetty address cannot just appear in the garden of settled identities; it arrives with capital, a sponsor, and original writing. Slashing duplicates sharpens it. The attacker pays a linear capital premium.
